item.title: It’s Hard Not To Love A Good Fender: COTD
item.description: One of the greatest parts about being a car enthusiast is learning what makes someone’s heart skip. I’m a sucker for stupid engines, weird engineering, RGB lighting, and brightly-colored interiors that you could never sweat on or get dirty. Apparently, some of you like buttresses and fenders. David
